A Letter From the Founder

A kit where every detail is thought through by a girl, the way only girls can do it.

I built LENXI because I got tired of every self-care product adding another layer of complexity to my life. I was looking for ways to remove things, not add more of them.

So I designed a kit where every detail is thought through by a girl, the way only girls can do it. A kit that gives you more time than it takes and gives you room for yourself in your routine.

— Romi
